about: A hierarchy as an indented tree, each thing under the one it belongs to, joined by branch lines and arriving as it is named: classifications, families, organisations, parts of parts, kinds and sub-kinds.

links.about: parent>child pairs, split by |; the first parent is the root

highlight.about: names drawn in the accent, split by |

when.about: moments each row arrives, top to bottom; else when its name is said, or one after another
